race.comment: STRADA VARENNA (10) was a sharp improver second-up at Eagle Farm when letting down stylishly to score with a bit up his sleeve over this trip. With the in-form apprentice taking over, she meets a fair few of these better at the weights after beating them last time. Gets a great chance to make it two on the bounce. LIM'S SHAVANO (2) can give this a big shake second-up after hitting the line strongly for second when resuming at Eagle Farm. The return to 1200m is a genuine plus given his strong record at the trip and 2kgs comes off with another handy apprentice in taking over but he'll need to be on top of his game from out there. CANAL (18) has impressed in the new colours with two dominant wins. Goes up a rung or two now though and is drawn sticky. Watch for him charging late. BEREZKA (5) hit her peak with a third-up win and could strike again.
